notes.title: A hot update for these hot summer days!
notes.content:
Hi There,

We hope that all of you are safe and enjoying the summer! We are glad to inform you the release of our latest update which does contain many bug fixes for issues found in game and menu. We sadly don't have any new feature added at this time but expect more features coming in the following days!

Thanks a lot as usual for all your support, stay safe and keep gaming! ;)

Regards,

Creamative

notes.title: Another small patch for enemy being stuck outside the screen
notes.content:
Hi There,

It has been reported that occasionally enemies get stuck outside the screen thus not allowing the game to advance unless you hit them with your special attack or shuriken/knife throws. This release aims to fix this and  please let us know if you encounter any such issue from now on?

Regards,

Creamative

notes.title: A small patch for Keyboard crash introduced in the latest update!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

It seems our latest update, which included the new player bots feature, caused a crash if you were trying to play the game with Keyboard starting from the Tutorial level. This small patch fixes this.

Our apologies and keep gaming!

Regards,

Creamative

notes.title: Black Friday update, not only the price! :)
notes.content:
Hey There,

[b]Black Friday[/b] is here and so is our newest update! ːsteamhappyː

First is the update on pricing where we applied a whopping [b]40% discount[/b], enjoy!

Second, we just released a new version which contains some new features and fixes as outlined below :

1) We now have a new mode named [b]Extra Enemy[/b] which you can enable/disable through the [b]Settings[/b]. First unvelied in our [b]Fighting Sale [/b] broadcasts, this is especially designed for experts on gaming ːsteammockingː, who are looking for extra challenge. When enabled, it allows you to fight against more enemies in quantity and to be honest, we still couldn't complete the game with it enabled coupled with [b]Hard[/b] difficulty ːsteamsadː.
2) You can now tumble with using left gamepad stick when left trigger is pressed as well. This is especially designed if you are using an arcade stick setup where there is only one stick available so you can map the left trigger to a button for tumbling.
3) We have re-worked on Level End Boss AIs to re-balance and update their fighting skills.
4) We have fixed some in game level visua erros as well as some gameplay glitches.

well, that's all! We are still working on a bigger update which will include the new bot players feature and hope to have it ready by Christmas as a present. ːsteamhappyː

Until than, stay safe and keep gaming!

Regards,

Creamative

notes.title: Update 2 is out and also a question?
notes.content:
Hey There,

Hope all of you are well and keeping gaming! Today we are happy to provide you our second update with these enhancements :

[list]
[*] You can now cancel your attack immediately if you block. This was a quite asked feature and we are happy to finally bring it to you. One thing to note is that this applies to ground attacks and not any combos attacks you do while you are on the air! ːsteammockingː
[*] We have tweaked ackward scroll points in the levels.
[*] Now you can see how many continues you have once you have been asked to continue.
[*] Many small bug fixes and visual tweaks.
[/list]

These enhancements are available immediately in the full game as well as in the current demo.

Now, to the question we would like to ask, this has been asked as a pool on Twitter but wanetd to reach out to you through here as well. So the question is :

[b]"When you play Clan N as solo or less than 4 players, would you like to have bot players to fill out up to 4 players to accompany you through your journey?

Just one note, we anticipate this as an optional feature and not something forced, so you'll always have the option to play without bots as it's now!"[/b]

Let us know what you think in the comments below and stay safe while keeping gaming! ːsteamhappyː

Regards,

Creamative

notes.title: Update 1 is now out!
notes.content:
Hey There,

We finally launched our game last week and thank you all for your support on that!

It's great to see all the reactions and reviews we got. Instead of resting, we heard you and carefully went over all your feedback whether it's a bug report or criticism and here we are with our first update which includes these improvements so far :

[list]
[*] Online play now allows you to continue where you left off! This means whether you are playing local or online, you can hop back to your progress to resume. There is a simple rule on online, on random matchmaking, you'll get matched with people who are at the same check point as you are and if you invite a friend to play together, your the inviters chekcpoint is where the game will resume.
[*] We have fixed all known stability issues on the Online play and tested it for quite some hours to ensure there is no visible issue to interrupt your experience.
[*] New short campaign mode! We found out that some of you wanted a shorter experience for a more arcade like feeling in duration so that's now possible with short campaign.
[*] We have tweaked the levels and some small gameplay elements for better phasing.
[*] Some other additional fixes on some visual litches and similar.
[/list]

We once again appreciate everybodies feedback so far and keep them coming so we can improve your experience!

Enjoy, stay safe and keep gaming!

Regards,

Creamative

notes.title: Demo update...
notes.content:
Hello Everybody,

As promised, we are happy to let you know the immediate availability of the final demo of [b]Clan N[/b]. We currently named it as Beta in case there is any bug hidden that needs to be squashed but otherwise, it represents the final game.

Here's the full list on what is new on the demo :

- A new fancy intro, yeah! ːsteamhappyː
- Full keyboard support along with the previous controller support. Only one player can play via the keyboard so for any others, you still need attached gamepad(s).
- Multilanguage UI support.
- Your demo progress is now saved. Although it's not that long of a journey to complete, if you happen to leave it before completion, you now have the option to continue from where you left off.
- Ability to play the first level's minigame, [b]Dodge the Rocks[/b], in standalone form, which is perfect for solo or multiplayer highscore attemps. But, don't forget that, all minigames first need to be unlocked through the campaign in order to play as standalone!
- Ofcourse, it also contains the fast paced, addictive hack'n'slash gameplay in final form you glimpsed in the previous demo. ːsteammockingː

Hope you'll like what you see and don't forget to let us know if you notice any bug or sort! We'll get back soon again with exciting more news while we are gearing towards the release, until than, take care, stay home and keep gaming!

Regards,

Creamative
